messages:
frank: Quick thought: what if we regroup the left rail into three clean clusters labeled Collections, Models, Platform? Goal: faster scan, stable deep-links, and clearer breadcrumbs for compact rails. Thoughts?
nora: Collections feels a bit abstract. Can we test 'Collections' vs 'Projects' in micro-research? Also curious how crumbs behave when rail is icon-only.
sam: Accessibility first: collapsed clusters must be actual buttons (aria-expanded) and we must ensure visible focus when users keyboard into the rail. Skip link should jump to #main and be first tabbable element.
leigh: UX nit: propose a small persistent cluster chip left of breadcrumbs ("[Collections]") for compact rail so we don't bloat the crumbs. The chip can be visually subtle but helpful.
frank: Love the chip idea. Implementation detail: permalinks should include cluster slug so resolving is deterministic across workspaces: /ws/:id/cluster:collections/item/:iid. If item not present in current workspace, fallback to cluster hub with a toast.
nora: Important: when fallback happens, show a non-modal banner near breadcrumbs with action "Try original workspace". Dont auto-switch. Also ensure SR announcement: "Linked item not found in this workspace."
sam: Dev/aria: breadcrumb nav needs role=navigation and aria-label="Breadcrumbs". The chip can be aria-hidden if the same text is exposed via list items to avoid duplication. Leaf crumb should have aria-current="page".
leigh: For compact mode, we should offer a user pref: Navigation: Compact / Expanded / Auto. Hover-to-expand is fine as a convenience, but not the only way to access items (keyboard users need a toggle).
nora: Copy options for the chip: Option A: "Collections" (concise), Option B: "Projects" (more product friendly). I'll run a 48h poll.
nav-bot: [ci] nav-deeplink-highlight: flaky on compact-icon-only mode. Observed mismatch: leaf highlight goes to wrong cluster in ~6% runs. Ticket ENG-5102.
frank: Eli-ish: Sam, can you add a unit test asserting highlight priority: exact leaf > section > cluster? Also add an integration test for permalink fallback toast.
sam: On it. I'll add tests and an e2e that simulates landing on /ws/100/cluster:collections/item/abc when abc exists in ws-7 but not ws-100; assert toast shown and focus not stolen.
leigh: Accessibility check: focus ring must be visible in compact and expanded modes. Also add keyboard-only video capture for the PR.
nora: I'll draft chip vs crumb mockups in Figma and share before EOD. Suggest we A/B test chip vs explicit cluster crumb for a week.
frank: Sync tomorrow 9:30 PT. Agenda: 1) test results for highlight bug 2) ARIA audit notes 3) copy poll results 4) A/B test plan. nav-bot: [reminder] sync scheduled 2513459400
sam: Thanks team. Adding details to the PR description with aria checklist and test pointers.
leigh: LGTM. :thumbsup:
